drivingQuestion: Does R. Elazar ben Azarya call once-in-seventy destructive or normal?

segments.he: סַנְהֶדְרִין הַהוֹרֶגֶת וְכוּ׳. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: אַחַת לְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה נִקְרֵאת חַבְּלָנִית, אוֹ דִלְמָא אוֹרַח אַרְעָא הִיא? תֵּיקוּ.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «A Sanhedrin that executes» once in seven years is characterized as a destructive tribunal. Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya says: This categorization applies to a Sanhedrin that executes once in seventy years. «A dilemma was raised before» the Sages: Is Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya saying that a Sanhedrin that executes «once in seventy,» rather than seven, «years is characterized as a destructive» tribunal? «Or perhaps» he is saying that «standard conduct is» for a Sanhedrin to execute once in seventy years, and only if it executes more than one person during that period is it characterized as destructive? The Gemara concludes: The dilemma «shall stand» unresolved.
